memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab. His division numbers 74,600. The tribe of Issachar will camp next to them... The tribe of Zebulun will camp next to them... All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first. - Num 2:3-9 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Judah is placed on the east side, toward the sunrise, and is given the honour of leading the way. Whenever Israel moved, Judah went first. This was no accident. God was quietly pointing forward to something far greater.

Judah means "praise." So the tribe that led God's people forward was, in a sense, the tribe of praise. There is a lesson here for us: when we move forward with praise, we move in the right direction. Praise is not something we do only when life is easy; it is meant to lead the way even into uncertain days.

But there is something deeper still. From the tribe of Judah, generations later, the Lord Jesus Christ would come — the Lion of the tribe of Judah (Rev 5:5). The tribe that led Israel through the wilderness pointed ahead to the One who leads all of God's people home.

Notice too that Judah camped toward the sunrise — toward the dawn. Christ is our sunrise, the light who scatters our darkness (Luke 1:78-79).

Today, let praise go before you. And remember that the true Leader of your life has already gone ahead of you, making the way.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you let praise lead the way, even in hard times?
- How does it comfort you that Christ leads God's people forward?
- What "sunrise" hope do you need from God today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, Lion of Judah, thank You for leading Your people. Teach me to move forward with praise, trusting You to go before me. Amen.
